run_train_one_epoch: run train_one_epoch to train a PyTorch model for one epoch with gradient accumulation and mixed precision
run_evaluate: run evaluate to assess a PyTorch model on a test data loader and report accuracy metrics
refactor_train_one_epoch: refactor train_one_epoch to support a custom loss scaler or different gradient clipping strategy
refactor_evaluate: refactor evaluate to use a custom criterion instead of CrossEntropyLoss for multi-label tasks
review_train_one_epoch: review train_one_epoch to understand its learning rate scheduling, mixup augmentation, and logging logic
